name: comp-580

frames.best_why: The search field holds a typed query with a clear button; the rest of the bar is complete.

tagline: Store header with category links, a search box and a cart badge.
summary: A dark ecommerce top bar with a starburst logo, Products, Categories and Deals links, a search field with a magnifier, a Sign In action and a white Cart button showing a count.
appearance: A dark header bar with a starburst logo, three small category links, a rounded search field with a magnifier icon, a plain Sign In button and a white rounded Cart pill holding a faint 2.
behaviour: Typing in the search box highlights its border and shows the query with a native clear button, while the rest of the bar stays still. The category links and buttons only react on hover.
demo_content: The search placeholder reads Search...; the typed example is running shoes and the cart badge shows 2.
use_when: An online store needs search and a cart always visible in the top bar.
avoid_when: Search is a plain field with no suggestions, and categories are fixed links with no dropdown.
customise: The logo, three category labels, cart count and search placeholder are fixed copy inside the file; colours follow theme tokens.
weight_why: A row of links, one input and two buttons.

a11y.note: The search field relies on its placeholder rather than a label, and the logo link has no accessible name.

issues: The cart count 2 is very faint against the white Cart button.
polish_why: Tidy, evenly spaced header with a clear search; the cart count is low contrast.
title: Ecommerce Search Navbar
